void.$description: Void — Page background, primary canvas — the dark field that holds every piece of work

chalk.$description: Chalk — Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and card edges on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ivory.$description: Ivory — Button labels and button borders — marginally warmer than Chalk, used on neutral pill buttons to feel pressed but not clinical

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary link and body text, subdued dividers — mid-gray for de-emphasized type that still needs to read

graphite.$description: Graphite — Heading borders and low-emphasis heading text — darker mid-gray that recedes behind primary Chalk type

smoke.$description: Smoke — Badge text — sits between Ash and Charcoal, calm and unreadable as ornament

steel.$description: Steel — Badge borders — paired with Smoke text for outlined tag affordance

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Elevated surface for the single neutral filled button — barely lighter than Void so the button whispers rather than shouts

wand-ui-pro.$description: Sole typeface — used for everything from 96px display headlines down to 10px badge labels. The 475 and 550 weights are the workhorses; 650 is reserved for emphasis. The font is custom but has the personality of a contemporary geometric grotesk with subtle humanist warmth, tight apertures, and a tall x-height.
